_help.about: The dark closes in (design 30 Sept §BA). Between camps at night, exposure accumulates in a hidden meter; light holds it off; stages are heard before they are seen; at the top it takes you. Never a health-bar fight. Restart after editing.
_help.meter: Fill per real minute in full dark / under a moon / with a lit torch in hand or planted within torch range; drain per minute inside a lit fire's radius; dawn empties it. dusk_grace_min: minutes after dusk before it starts filling.
_help.stages: In order; 'at' is the meter level that starts the stage. Each names its cue. Stage 5 only takes you if there is no light on you or you are farther than far_from_fire_m from a lit fire.
_help.patterns: How a hunter approaches. pacer: parallel at a distance, faster than you (you cannot outrun it, only out-light it). circler: circles before it closes, heard from changing bearings. stalker: moves only while you move, freezes when you stop. waiter: sits still on the road ahead; you walk into it.
_help.hunters: biome keys -> the creature (name in data/creatures/creatures.json, role mythical) and its pattern. creature null = the dark itself: a cloaked shape with no species, the fallback everywhere. 'first' marks the one to build first.
_help.rules: never_within_fire_m: no hunter inside a lit fire's radius. ignore_travellers: road travellers (§BF) walk unharmed. no_bestiary: nothing in the HUD names them.
_help.torch_circle: [NOT WIRED YET — design §CQ] The circle is how far the dark keeps back. A lit torch in hand, or a planted one within its own circle, fills the meter at fill_per_min_torch × reference_range_m ÷ that torch's circle (torch.json light.range_m × its kind's circle_scale), never faster than fill_never_above (moonlight): a rushlight barely beats the moon, birch bark buys the most. Stage 3's glimpses ('at the edge of the light') stand at the torch's circle plus glimpse_band_m, in place of the stage's fixed distance_m, so a small light lets the dark stand closer. First guesses by Claude (chat), 3 Oct; the designer owns them.
